description: Create recon.py - Full Passive Reconnaissance Engine. This module performs comprehensive subdomain enumeration, DNS analysis, technology fingerprinting, and historical URL discovery against target domains. All passive/semi-passive techniques only.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/monster/recon.py with a ReconEngine class that takes a domain and output_dir

Implement subdomain enumeration with multiple sources: (a) Certificate Transparency via crt.sh API (https://crt.sh/?q=%25.{domain}&output=json), (b) DNS bruteforce using wordlists/subdomains.txt with socket.getaddrinfo, (c) VirusTotal passive DNS (https://www.virustotal.com/vtapi/v2/domain/report if API key in config), (d) SecurityTrails API (if key provided), (e) Wayback Machine URL extraction (https://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=*.{domain}/*&output=json&fl=original&collapse=urlkey), (f) Common Crawl index search (http://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2024-10-index?url=*.{domain}&output=json)
Implement DNS record enumeration: resolve A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, SOA records for each discovered subdomain using subprocess dig or socket fallback

Implement technology fingerprinting: analyze HTTP response headers (Server, X-Powered-By, X-AspNet-Version, X-Generator, Via, X-Cache), cookies (JSESSIONID=Java, PHPSESSID=PHP, ASP.NET_SessionId=ASP.NET, __cfduid=Cloudflare), HTML meta generators, common JS framework indicators in body
Implement port scanning hints: check common web ports [80, 443, 8080, 8443, 3000, 5000, 9090, 8000, 8888, 4443] via socket.connect_ex with short timeout
Implement HTTP response analysis: GET each live subdomain, record status code, redirect chain, response size, interesting headers
Implement historical URL discovery via Wayback Machine CDX API, extract unique paths and parameters
Implement Google dorking query generator: site:domain, inurl:admin, filetype:pdf/sql/env/log/bak, intitle:index of, ext:php/asp/jsp
Implement Shodan query generator: build search strings like 'hostname:domain', 'ssl.cert.subject.CN:domain', 'http.title:domain'
Add a run() method that orchestrates all sub-modules in order with progress output via ColorOutput, stores results in a ReconResults dataclass, and saves to JSON file in output_dir
Support --dry-run flag that shows what would be done without making network calls
acceptance_criteria: ReconEngine('example.com', '/tmp/out').run() executes without crashing (may have limited results due to rate limits)
crt.sh subdomain enumeration returns parsed results for domains with CT logs
DNS resolution works for valid domains
Technology fingerprinting identifies server software from headers
Google dork and Shodan query generators produce valid search strings
All network errors are caught gracefully with informative messages
verification: python -c "from monster.recon import ReconEngine; print('recon import OK')"
python -c "from monster.recon import ReconEngine; r = ReconEngine('example.com', '/tmp/recon-test'); print(r.generate_google_dorks())"
python -c "from monster.recon import ReconEngine; r = ReconEngine('example.com', '/tmp/recon-test'); print(r.generate_shodan_queries())"
findings: All verification commands pass. ReconEngine imports cleanly, generates correct Google dorks and Shodan queries. Dry-run mode works as expected, skipping all network calls. ReconResults dataclass has all required fields. Uses HTTPClient, DNSResolver, ColorOutput, FileManager from utils.py. Uses TECH_SIGNATURES, GOOGLE_DORK_TEMPLATES, SHODAN_QUERY_TEMPLATES, COMMON_PORTS from config.py.
